contract_md:
- **POST-1** The input contains an integer \(N\) followed by exactly \(N\) integer heights. Both \(N\) and each height are in \([1,3000]\).
- **POST-2** The output consists of one integer token, with optional surrounding whitespace.
- **POST-3** The output is the maximum size of a nonempty selection of buildings whose heights are all equal and whose successive index gaps are all equal. A singleton always qualifies. Any two buildings of equal height qualify.
- **POST-4** The answer lies between 1 and the largest frequency of any height. It is at least the length of any contiguous run of equal heights, and at least 2 if a height repeats. A single building or an all-distinct sequence gives 1. An all-equal sequence gives \(N\).
- **POST-5** Reversing the line or applying an injective relabeling to its heights preserves the answer. Appending buildings can only increase or preserve the answer.
- **POST-6** The program must handle the full input bounds within the judge’s resource limits, including inputs with many repeated heights.

isolation.mechanism: hardened isolated codex exec (empty tmpdir, read-only, tool flags disabled, credentials stripped, full event-lifecycle audit including item.started)
